lines.text: I'll hold your bag. And your place.
You're so patient. Like a goat tied to a post.
Sorry! I'd stop, but I've only just got it going!
You all look so brave. Sitting down. In here.
I'd like to thank the lecturers. For the free time.
Six months! I have forgotten my own matric number.
I gave the bank my mother's. She has a first class now.
'Vote Nusaiba: She Has Already Organised You.'
Here we see the ballot in its natural habitat…
You look so calm! I love that for you.
Everything is on fire. Not literally. Yet.
Power, stage, guests, my roof, his portrait, a zip.
Welcome to our exhibition.
This piece is called 'NEPA'. It is interactive.
Torches out, please. You are the lighting department.
Look left. Look right. One of you owes the other money.
The roommates' toast. Please: keep it short. And clean.
Environmental Design. It's a lovely door. Needs a ramp.
Hi! You look so rested! Did you sleep in the queue again?
There you are! I love that you always arrive. Eventually.
Good morning! Your shirt is so brave today. Ha— sorry. It is.
Sannu! [Hello!] Come, I saved you a seat. And your bag. And your dignity.
Go well! You walk so confidently. In the wrong direction, but confidently.
Bye! Text me when you're home. Or when the network lets you.
Thank you! You're so thoughtful. Like a building with a ramp.
Sorry! I laughed before you finished. It was going to be funny. I could tell.
Your handwriting is so neat. Like a doctor's. Who studied art.
You're so patient. Like a goat tied to a post. Ha— no, it's a compliment.
I love your plan. It's so bold. It has no roof, but it's bold.
You're so calm in exams. Like a man who hasn't seen the paper yet.
I'm right behind you! Like a shadow with opinions.
Take your time! The building's only been standing since 1975.
That's the Bursary. It's a lovely door. Nobody comes out of it.
Yes! I love it. I'll fix it later, but I love it.
No, my dear. Gently. But no.
Maybe! I'll draw it first. On paper everything fits.
Wait. Draw me that. In plan and section.
Who? There was nobody there fa. You need water. And a nap.
Exactly! You're so wise. When did that happen?
I'd love to! I won't. But I'd love to.
Architects never die. They just lose their scale. Ha— sorry. Sorry.
Have you eaten? You look like a site that ran out of cement.
We won! I would cry, but I'm wearing my good mascara.
We lost. Beautifully. That counts in my faculty.
Ow! You're so strong. Like a door in harmattan.
I'm fine! I meant to sit. On the ground. Elegantly.
NEPA! My model has no lights. It's now a model of campus.
Light! Quick, save the file! SAVE IT!
Rain! The studio roof leaks right onto my site plan. It's a water feature now.
This heat. My tracing paper is sweating. I'm sweating. The T-square is fine.
Mama Nkechi's jollof. Smells like a client who pays on time.
Studio supplies cost more than my fees. Card, glue, tears.
For me? You're so kind! It fits on my drawing board. Barely.
Oh, I love it! I'll keep it somewhere very safe. Very far.
A horse figurine! You remembered! I'm not crying. The glue fumes are strong.
Ha— no. Too mean. Writing it down anyway.
Mallam Dogo's grey mare. So elegant. Unlike everything I've built.
Studio at 2 a.m. My model is beautiful. I've forgotten my own name.
I held your bag and your place. I still have the bag. Joking!
Forty people sat down when he said 'Network'. Like a wedding.
Registration survivor! You look so much older now. It's only been a week.
Twin Theatres. Same building, two names, every fresher lost. Great design.
Nusaiba has made me a timetable for my timetable. I love her. Help.
You matriculated as a kite. So graceful. So airborne.
Sorry I didn't stop! The keke had only just got going!
Lula and Faty argued for six streets. I want that marriage. Not that keke.
You're really good at this. At everything. It's a little annoying.
First night at Kadanya. Somebody's alarm went off at 3. They meant it.
Do you like horses? You can tell me. It's a safe space.
You're so busy now! A business, a radio show, a crisis. Love that.
Kwari Mall. Lovely glass. Zero shade. The architect has never been outside.
The mall has an escalator that doesn't move. That's a staircase with ambition.
You look so tired. Like a fresher who joined three clubs. Oh. You did.
You did the heist so calmly! Not that I know about any heist. What heist?
Faculty Week. The wiring caught fire in Engineering. We had a candle-lit crit.
I'll walk with you to the Spot! Nusaiba says we're both behind schedule.
Valentine's. I got a card. Unsigned. Lovely handwriting. Terrible spelling.
You stayed! You're so loyal. Or you had no bus fare. Either way, hi!
Six months of strike. I have forgotten my own matric number.
I'm cooking for the whole floor. Rice. More rice. Rice, but with love.
The open mic! I was shaking. You were laughing. Ha— that's the deal.
I thanked the lecturers. For the free time. Nobody's forgiven me.
You make the empty halls feel full. Mostly with noise, but full.
You've read the same page for three weeks. It must be a really good page.
Strike day ninety. I've redesigned my room four times. It's still a room.
No light, no water, no lectures. Very minimalist. Very me.
Degree show week! You look so calm! I love that for you. Hide me.
Everything is on fire. Not literally. Yet.
Power, stage, guests, roof, portrait, zip. In that order. Go.
My model roof was card and prayer. It held. The prayer did most of it.
'Vote Nusaiba: She Has Already Organised You.' My best work.
Ballot in its natural habitat. Shh. Don't startle it.
You re-routed four hundred guests. You should design airports.
You were in two places on Wednesday. Nobody can do that. Can you do it again?
Vote Nusaiba! She's already planned your vote. You just have to arrive.
Final year! You've grown so much. Mostly in debt to the photocopy man.
Hosting dinner night. I have twelve jokes. Eleven are about the people at table four.
My final project has a ramp. Every door should. I said it in the Senate.
Look left, look right. One of you owes the other money. Still true.
Environmental Design. Lovely door. Needed a ramp. I said it.
You'll be brilliant out there. Terrifying, but brilliant.
Your defence slides! So many colours! Your supervisor is colour-blind now.
Don't be strange after convocation. Be the normal strange. The one I know.
Freshers! I'll hold your bags. All of them. It's my thing.
Exam week. My drawing board has seen me cry more than my mother.
Results! I passed! Even Structures! Structures is shocked!
Allowance! Rich for one evening. I'll spend it on tracing paper. I'm a party.
Market day. I need card, glue and nothing else. I'm buying eleven things.
Education are in the final! I don't know the rules! I'm screaming anyway!
Don't make me cry. I've written a joke for this. I'll forget it. I'm crying.
Iftar at the mosque grounds? I'll carry the dates. And jokes. Light ones.
Christmas break. My aunt will ask why I draw houses and don't own one.
Valentine's. The Love Garden bench is fully booked. I've drawn a second bench.
Harmattan. My lips are cracked like my model's foundation.
